summary_1line: Dasharatha announces Rama’s coronation for the next day; Rama informs his family and prepares with Sita through vows and rituals.

image_candidates.scene_text: King Dasharatha embraces Rama in a private chamber while announcing his wish to crown him before ominous celestial signs bring misfortune.
Queen Kaushalya sits in a temple with closed eyes and controlled breath, praying to Narayana as Sita and Lakshmana sit beside her.
Rama bows before his mother and joyfully tells her that he and Sita will fast and perform sacred rites before his coronation at dawn.
